reader_summary.overview: In this Company episode of The Synopsis we draw on our 108-page research report on Airbnb. Having started as a means to pay rent, Airbnb quickly turned into one of the world's largest accommodations provider. In a matter of just a decade, Airbnb was able to host more guests than Hilton could in 100 years.

key_points.text: In this Company episode of The Synopsis we draw on our 108-page research report on Airbnb.
However, despite their large impact in how tens of millions of people traveled and millions more monetized their unused properties.
That is until founder Brian Chesky decided to do something drastic and reshape the business—in the midst of Covid no less.
